purpose: Frozen, target-independent lookup bridge from Stage A-prime single-phoneme output keys to the existing Sanskrit consonant-varna profile keys, so B1.6 {VARNA_PROFILE_TABLE} can be populated later WITHOUT inventing target-specific mappings. Consonant-only; vowels carry no profile in the current tables and are excluded (never invented).

vrtti_gloss_reference.note: gloss/dictionary-like; excluded from any judge-facing surface

bridge_table.level: applied to single-phoneme keys AFTER Stage A-prime decomposition; does not modify the decomposer

coverage_audit.unreachable_reason: The decomposer splits most aspirated stops into base+'h' (kh->[k,h], gh->[g,h], ph->[p,h] or [f], bh->[b,h], retroflex Th/Dh->[tr/dr,h]) or collapses affricate aspiration (c/ch->'ch', j/jh->'jh'), so aspirated varna keys cannot be selected from the phoneme stream. 'ksha' is a conjunct (x->[k,s]) with no single phoneme. Dental th/dh are the exception (kept as single phonemes) and are reachable.
preserved_contrasts: dental vs retroflex: t/ta vs tr/tta, d/da vs dr/dda, n/na vs nr/nna
nasal place: na / nna / nga / nya
sibilants: s/sa (dental) vs sh/sha (palatal) vs shr/ssa (retroflex)

policies.vowel_policy: VOWEL_NO_PROFILE: vowels (and vocalic rv) are retained in VARNA_SEQUENCE, marked VOWEL_NO_PROFILE, excluded from VARNA_PROFILE_TABLE; the scaffold states vowel profiles are unavailable; no vowel meanings invented.
policies.unsupported_policy: UNSUPPORTED_SEGMENT: f, z, zh (and any future unmatched phoneme) are retained in the sequence, marked UNSUPPORTED_NO_VARNA, excluded from the profile lookup, and reported visibly; never silently dropped or coerced.
policies.ambiguity_policy: Map only single phonemes that resolve to exactly one existing varna key. Aspiration-bearing distinctions the decomposer does not carry are recorded as collapses (not silently merged into a new key). No conservative default is used where it would fabricate a distinction.
policies.no_target_tuning: The bridge is frozen before any B1.6 target freeze and must not change after seeing target outputs or judge scores.
policies.english_vs_sanskrit: Same bridge for both tracks (both decompose to the shared 39-phoneme inventory). A_PRIME_SA transliteration may preserve retroflex/palatal/sibilant distinctions that A_PRIME_EN collapses, but neither recovers aspiration for velar/labial/palatal stops. Any language-specific rule must be frozen before target selection; none is added here.

downstream_still_required: {KCPR_CONTEXT_FRAME} resolution or drop (KCPR_EXPANSION_NOT_FOUND; no kosha lexicon)
